slides.texte_overlay:
How to become a completely
new man from the inside
Decide who you are becoming, in one sentence. "I'm a calm, healthy man who keeps his word." Every choice gets easier when you know who you're becoming.
Stop telling the old story about yourself. "I've always been lazy" keeps you lazy. Talk about yourself as the man you're becoming instead.
Change one daily ritual first. Coffee on the balcony instead of in bed with your phone. Small new rituals make the change feel real.
Let go of grudges. Anger at old friends or exes keeps you living in the past. Forgiving frees energy for the man you want to be. It frees your mind.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. New ideas every morning slowly change the way you see everything.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. New ideas every morning slowly change the way you see everything.

slides.texte_overlay: Be patient with yourself. Real change takes months, not days. Falling back once doesn't erase the progress you already made. Progress isn't a straight line.
Help someone else grow. Teaching a friend or mentoring someone younger reminds you how far you've already come. It's the best proof you've changed.
